notes: Claude API list prices, global endpoints. Batch API halves input and output. US-only inference (inference_geo us) costs 1.1 times.

Bedrock prices were not confirmed on the AWS pricing page on 2026-09-25. Anthropic's page says regional and multi-region Bedrock endpoints cost 10% more than global ones for Claude 4.5 and later. Confirm at https://aws.amazon.com/bedrock/pricing/ before publishing numbers.
